item.title: BIRN Kosovo Marks Anniversary of Ukraine Invasion with Fifth Doc on Russian Disinformation
item.description: Photo: BIRN Kosovo On 24 February, marking the fourth anniversary of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, BIRN Kosovo and Internews Kosovo premiered the fifth and final documentary in their investigative series about disinformation and foreign malign influence. The post BIRN Kosovo Marks Anniversary of Ukraine Invasion with Fifth Doc on Russian Disinformation appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN Montenegro Analysis Calls for Stronger Crypto Sector Regulation
item.description: Photo: BIRN Montenegro Analysis reveals existence of large unregistered and uncontrolled money flows through the crypto market ‘about which our state knows nothing’. The post BIRN Montenegro Analysis Calls for Stronger Crypto Sector Regulation appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: Bosnian Canton Incorporates Judicially Established Facts into Teaching
item.description: Photo: Detektor.ba Bosnian Podrinje canton signs memorandum on using BIRN’s Database of Judicially Established Facts about the War in Bosnia in schools. The post Bosnian Canton Incorporates Judicially Established Facts into Teaching appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: Meet the People Behind BIRN: Maida Selmanovic
item.description: Photo: Private archive Maida Selmanovic is the Financial Director in BIRN Hub’s office in Sarajevo. She studied at the University of Economic Tourism and has been working with BIRN since 2008. The post Meet the People Behind BIRN: Maida Selmanovic appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN Alumnus Journalist Wins Environmental Award in North Macedonia
item.description: Photo: BIRN Journalist Bojan Blazevski’s investigation into the phosphogypsum landfill in North Macedonia won second place in the 2025 competition for the best journalistic story on tackling the consequences of air pollution in the country awarded by the Macedonian Journalists’ Association and UNDP. The post BIRN Alumnus Journalist Wins Environmental Award in North Macedonia appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN Albania Publishes Report on Identity-Based Disinformation and Its Impact on Democratic Debate
item.description: Photo: BIRN BIRN Albania has published a new research report examining the dynamics of identity-based disinformation and its impact on democratic discourse, vulnerable communities and the broader information environment. The post BIRN Albania Publishes Report on Identity-Based Disinformation and Its Impact on Democratic Debate appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN Journalist Radmilo Markovic Receives Anti-Corruption Award
item.description: Photo: The National Coalition for Decentralisation Radmilo Marković has received the Svetionicari [Beacon] award for outstanding contribution in the fight against corruption in Serbia. The post BIRN Journalist Radmilo Markovic Receives Anti-Corruption Award appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: In Memoriam – Mila Moralic
item.description: Photo: Private archive Croatian journalist Mila Moralic has passed away at the age of 45. She will be remembered as an outstanding colleague whose dedication to strengthening her profession will be deeply missed. The post In Memoriam – Mila Moralic appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN Albania Wins Landmark Constitutional Court Case
item.description: Photo: LSA Albania’s Constitutional Court ruled on Tuesday that a government decision to block the social media platform TikTok violated freedom of expression and press freedom, upholding a complaint filed by BIRN Albania and the Albanian Association of Journalists. The post BIRN Albania Wins Landmark Constitutional Court Case appeared first on BIRN.

item.title: BIRN and SCiDEV Publish Annual Report on Media Freedom and Safety in Albania
item.description: Photo: BIRN Albania BIRN Albania and SCiDEV have published a new report providing a detailed overview of developments affecting media freedom, pluralism and the safety of journalists in Albania during 2025. The post BIRN and SCiDEV Publish Annual Report on Media Freedom and Safety in Albania appeared first on BIRN.
